elapsed_seconds_scope: evaluate() loop only (time.perf_counter around evaluate()); excludes interpreter start, fixture load and validation, CSV rendering and write, and run-record write
methodology: Deterministic stdlib-only fixture. 30 scripted facts with explicit valid-time windows; ground truth is defined by those windows. Four modelled store policies, two query instants and a seeded 10% mis-extraction arm are evaluated in 16 cells. No product, model or graph database is executed and no network call is made.

timing.loop_scope: in-script measurement around evaluate() only, recorded by the script itself
timing.whole_process_wall_method: external wall clock (time.perf_counter in a parent Python process) around `python3 scripts/stale_fact_fixture.py` in default mode, from interpreter start to exit; run on a copy of scripts/, fixtures/ and results/ in the run's scratch directory, with the same script and fixture sha256 as recorded under inputs
timing.note: Appended after the r0 review queried an earlier 0.05 s whole-script figure that no artifact carried. Sub-0.1 s timings are host- and load-dependent; an independent review re-measurement on the same host gave 0.07 s. The script itself records only the loop figure, so a re-run reproduces elapsed_seconds but not this block.
timing.measurement_note: These five repeats also reproduced the in-script loop figure (elapsed_seconds 0.0042) from the original run, which is why the loop value in this record is retained unchanged.
